steps.name: sdk-consumer
command:
set -eu
unset QORE_MODULE_DIR QORE_MODULE_DIR_ONLY QORE_INCLUDE_DIR LD_LIBRARY_PATH LD_PRELOAD NODE_OPTIONS NODE_PATH
unset QORE_TYPESCRIPT_MASTER_ACTION_SCRIPT QORE_TYPESCRIPT_ACTION_SCRIPTS QORE_TYPESCRIPT_ACTION_TEST_SCRIPTS
unset QORE_DATA_PROVIDERS QORE_CONNECTION_PROVIDERS QORE_DATASOURCE_PROVIDERS QORE_PROVIDER_INDEX_DIR
export QORE_V8_TEST_MODULE_DIR=/usr/lib64/qore-modules QORE_V8_TEST_QMOD_DIR=/usr/lib64/qore-modules
rpm -V libnode137 libnode-devel qore-v8-module
sh debian/tests/compiler

steps.name: runtime-tests
command:
set -eu
unset QORE_MODULE_DIR QORE_MODULE_DIR_ONLY QORE_INCLUDE_DIR LD_LIBRARY_PATH LD_PRELOAD NODE_OPTIONS NODE_PATH
unset QORE_TYPESCRIPT_MASTER_ACTION_SCRIPT QORE_TYPESCRIPT_ACTION_SCRIPTS QORE_TYPESCRIPT_ACTION_TEST_SCRIPTS
unset QORE_DATA_PROVIDERS QORE_CONNECTION_PROVIDERS QORE_DATASOURCE_PROVIDERS QORE_PROVIDER_INDEX_DIR
export QORE_V8_TEST_MODULE_DIR=/usr/lib64/qore-modules QORE_V8_TEST_QMOD_DIR=/usr/lib64/qore-modules
for p in qore-devel gcc gcc-c++ libnode-devel; do if rpm -q "$p"; then exit 1; fi; done
rpm -V libnode137 qore-v8-module qore-v8-module-doc
./v8-smoke
sh debian/tests/cli
for suite in test/*.qtest; do
 timeout 600 qore -b --enable-debug -l v8  -l /usr/lib64/qore-modules/TypeScriptProxy/TypeScriptProxy.qmod  -l /usr/lib64/qore-modules/TypeScriptActionInterface/TypeScriptActionInterface.qmod "$suite" -v
done
